newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BOE'S George - further rate hikes probably needed.
newsitem.headline: BOE'S George - further rate hikes probably needed.

text.p: Bank of England governor Eddie George said on Monday that the last Bank of England rate rise was extremely helpful and that there was probably a need for further increases.
"We said in the inflation report that we probably will need at some point to do some further rise. But the fact that we moved early is extremely helpful," George said.
George was in Basle to attend the monthly meeting of the G10 central bankers at the Bank for International Settlements.
He was responding to reporters' questions about whether the most recent U.K. rate rise would stem inflationary pressures.
"It certainly serves to limit the rise that may ultimately become necessary," George said of the most recent U.K. rate increase.
The Bank of England raised its minimum lending rate by one-quarter point on October 30 to 6.0 percent.
